blocks.text: Any person who violates the provisions of this article is guilty of a misdemeanor. Upon conviction, a person shall be sentenced to a fine not to exceed $499.00 and/or imprisonment not to exceed 30 days. (Ord. 20224 § 7, 12-3-19.)
